summary: All pages are visually intact on desktop and mobile with perfect accessibility, best-practices, and SEO scores. The homepage performance recovered from 79 to 88 (LCP improved ~638 ms, TBT dropped 154 ms), while both project-detail pages remain persistently below 85 due to elevated LCPs above 4.3 s.
